newsitem.title: USA: Gehl Co 1996 tax rate higher.
newsitem.headline: Gehl Co 1996 tax rate higher.

text.p: Gehl Co, which makes construction and agricultural equipment, said Wednesday its tax rate for 1996 was 23.4 percent in 1996 compared with a rate of only two percent in 1995.
The majority of the company's net operating loss carryforwards were utilized in years prior to 1996, which accounted for the higher tax rate, it added.

Gehl said its pretax income for 1996 was $12.5 million, up 36 percent from $9.2 million in 1995. But after tax, its net income for 1996 was $9.6 million, up about six percent from $9.0 million a year ago.
The income tax provision for 1996 was $2.9 million, compared with $150,000 a year ago.

"The markets for our products were strong throughout the year," William Gehl, chairman, said in a statement. "Increased demand coupled with improvements in our operations as a result of asset management initiatives, distribution rationalization and more efficient plant utilization, led to 1996's record profit."
